statement: The complete global section spaces unramified outside{3,7} for the actual cubic geometric pro-three group, its intrinsic metabelian quotient and its class-two quotient. The full class-two abelian image is the union of nine cusp rays modulo9 with the exact horizontal criterion r(U-k_D) in(T-I)V+Z3 e_D. All nine quotient maps have C3^5+C9^2, with explicit Smith inverses. The universal inertia lattice is9W. Every fixed-abelian fibre is Z3^25+C3^9+C9^5, and every fixed-inertia fibre is Z3^31+C3^(9+t)+C9^5, with t3 on3W and0 otherwise. All full and metabelian ramified classes have literal cusp packet coordinates(D,r,b,[g]), with r nonzero, b in{0,1,2}, and[g] in H^J\H. Explicit anti-fixed Hall/Chen coordinates evaluate the latter quotient in every degree. The actual full→metabelian map is onto on ramified classes with every fibre(R^J\R), R=N'', and exact product ranks beginning504 in degree4. An explicit global class-two section with inertia9(eA0+eB0) has no metabelian or full lift.
